parameters.description_en:
The disk size of a single core node. Unit: GB.
  • If the instance is a single-node instance, the disk size of a single core node ranges from 20 to 500 GB, with a step size of 1 GB.
  • If the instance uses cloud disks, the disk size of a single core node ranges from 400 to 64,000 GB, with a step size of 40 GB.
  • If the instance uses local disks, the disk size of a single core node depends on the core node specifications:
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d1.4xlarge, the disk size is 44,000.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d1.6xlarge, the disk size is 66,000.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d1.8xlarge, the disk size is 88,000.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.xlarge, the disk size is 894.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.2xlarge, the disk size is 1,788.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.4xlarge, the disk size is 3,576.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.8xlarge, the disk size is 7,152.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d2s.5xlarge, the disk size is 58,400.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d2s.10xlarge, the disk size is 109,500.
parameters.description_zh:
Core单节点磁盘大小，单位：GB。
  • 如果实例为单节点，Core单节点磁盘容量的范围为20~500 GB，步长为1 GB。
  • 如果实例为云盘版，Core单节点磁盘容量的范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB。
  • 如果实例为本地盘，Core单节点磁盘容量与Core节点规格有关，具体如下：
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d1.4xlarge时，磁盘容量为44000。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d1.6xlarge时，磁盘容量为66000。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d1.8xlarge时，磁盘容量为88000。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.xlarge时，磁盘容量为894。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.2xlarge时，磁盘容量为1788。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.4xlarge时，磁盘容量为3576。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.8xlarge时，磁盘容量为7152。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d2s.5xlarge时，磁盘容量为58400。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d2s.10xlarge时，磁盘容量为109500。

> 当前云盘版加密开启后无法关闭
parameters.name: encryption_key

v1_parameters.description_en:
Settings for the auto-renewal period of the instance. Unit: months.

> - The default value is **0**, which indicates that the instance is not automatically renewed after the instance expires.
- For example, if the value is set to **2**, the instance is automatically renewed for two months after the instance expires.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
设置实例自动续费周期，单位为月。

> - 自动续费周期默认值为**0**，表示实例到期后不自动续费。
- 例如自动续费周期设置为**2**，表示实例到期后自动续费2个月。
v1_parameters.name: AutoRenewPeriod

v1_parameters.description_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
v1_parameters.name: ClientToken

v1_parameters.description_en:
The name of the instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
- The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.
- The name can contain digits and special characters, including periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
v1_parameters.description_zh:
实例名称。命名规则为：

- 长度为2~128个字符。
- 以大小写字母或中文开头。
- 可包含数字或者特殊字符，特殊字符包括半角句号（.）、短横线（-）和下划线（_）。
v1_parameters.name: ClusterName

v1_parameters.description_en:
The cold storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB. Valid values:
- **0**: Cold storage is disabled.
- **800** to **1000000**: Cold storage is enabled.

> Cold storage takes effect only when the engine type is **hbaseue**.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
实例的冷存储容量大小，单位为GB。取值如下：
- 取值为**0**：表示不开启冷存储。
- 取值范围为**800**~**1000000**：表示开启冷存储。

> 仅当实例的引擎类型为**hbaseue**时，开启冷存储功能才有效。
v1_parameters.name: ColdStorageSize

v1_parameters.description_en: The node specifications of the core node. You can invoke the [DescribeAvailableResource](~~188244~~) operation to query the specifications.
v1_parameters.description_zh: Core节点规格，可调用[DescribeAvailableResource](~~188244~~)接口获取规格值。
v1_parameters.name: CoreInstanceType

v1_parameters.description_en:
The disk size of a single core node. Unit: GB.
  • If the instance is a single-node instance, the disk size of a single core node ranges from 20 to 500 GB, with a step size of 1 GB.
  • If the instance uses cloud disks, the disk size of a single core node ranges from 400 to 64,000 GB, with a step size of 40 GB.
  • If the instance uses local disks, the disk size of a single core node depends on the core node specifications:
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d1.4xlarge, the disk size is 44,000.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d1.6xlarge, the disk size is 66,000.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d1.8xlarge, the disk size is 88,000.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.xlarge, the disk size is 894.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.2xlarge, the disk size is 1,788.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.4xlarge, the disk size is 3,576.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.i2.8xlarge, the disk size is 7,152.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d2s.5xlarge, the disk size is 58,400.
    • If the core node specifications are hbase.d2s.10xlarge, the disk size is 109,500.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
Core单节点磁盘大小，单位：GB。
  • 如果实例为单节点，Core单节点磁盘容量的范围为20~500 GB，步长为1 GB。
  • 如果实例为云盘版，Core单节点磁盘容量的范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB。
  • 如果实例为本地盘，Core单节点磁盘容量与Core节点规格有关，具体如下：
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d1.4xlarge时，磁盘容量为44000。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d1.6xlarge时，磁盘容量为66000。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d1.8xlarge时，磁盘容量为88000。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.xlarge时，磁盘容量为894。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.2xlarge时，磁盘容量为1788。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.4xlarge时，磁盘容量为3576。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.i2.8xlarge时，磁盘容量为7152。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d2s.5xlarge时，磁盘容量为58400。
    • Core节点规格为hbase.d2s.10xlarge时，磁盘容量为109500。
v1_parameters.name: DiskSize

v1_parameters.description_en:
The cloud disk type of the core node. Valid values:
  • **cloud_efficiency**: ultra cloud disk.
  • **cloud_ssd**: standard SSD.
  • **local_hdd_pro**: local HDD.
  • **local_ssd_pro**: local SSD.
  • **cloud_essd_pl1**: ESSD.
.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
实例的Core磁盘类型，取值：
  • **cloud_efficiency**：高效云盘。
  • **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘。
  • **local_hdd_pro**：本地HDD盘。
  • **local_ssd_pro**：本地SSD盘。
  • **cloud_essd_pl1**：ESSD云盘。
v1_parameters.name: DiskType

v1_parameters.description_en:
The encryption key ID. This parameter is empty if encryption is not enabled.

> After cloud disk encryption is enabled, it cannot be disabled.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
加密的密钥ID，如果未启用加密则为空。

> 当前云盘版加密开启后无法关闭。
v1_parameters.name: EncryptionKey

v1_parameters.description_en:
The database engine type. Valid values:
- **hbase**: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition or ApsaraDB for HBase single-node edition.
- **hbaseue**: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition.
- **bds**: BDS instance.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
数据库引擎类型：
- **hbase**：HBase标准版或HBase单机版。
- **hbaseue**：HBase增强版。
- **bds**：表示BDS实例。
v1_parameters.name: Engine

v1_parameters.description_en:
Database engine version of the instance. The value depends on the engine type. Valid values:
- If the engine type is **hbase**, database engine version is **1.1** or **2.0**.
- If the engine type is **hbaseue**, database engine version is **2.0**.
- If the engine type is **bds**, database engine version is **1.0**.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
实例的引擎版本，与引擎类型有关，取值：
- 如果实例的引擎类型为**hbase**，引擎版本为**1.1**或者**2.0**。
- 如果实例的引擎类型为**hbaseue**，引擎版本为**2.0**。
- 如果实例的引擎类型为**bds**，引擎版本为**1.0**。
v1_parameters.name: EngineVersion

v1_parameters.description_en: The node specifications of the master node. You can invoke the [DescribeAvailableResource](~~188244~~) operation to query the specifications.
v1_parameters.description_zh: Master节点规格，可调用[DescribeAvailableResource](~~188244~~)接口获取规格值。
v1_parameters.name: MasterInstanceType

v1_parameters.description_en:
The number of core nodes. Valid values:
  • If the instance is a single-node instance, the number of core nodes is fixed to **1**.
  • If the instance uses cloud disks, the number of core nodes ranges from **2** to **100**.
  • If the instance uses local disks, the number of core nodes ranges from **4** to **100**.
.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
Core节点个数，取值如下：
  • 如果实例为单节点，Core节点个数固定为**1**个。
  • 如果实例为云盘版，Core节点个数取值范围为**2**~**100**。
  • 如果实例为本地盘，Core节点个数取值范围为**4**~**100**。
v1_parameters.name: NodeCount

v1_parameters.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
- **Prepaid**: subscription.
- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：
- **Prepaid**：包年包月（预付费）。
- **Postpaid**：按量付费（后付费）。
v1_parameters.name: PayType

v1_parameters.description_en:
The subscription period of the subscription instance. Valid values:
- If PeriodUnit is set to **year**, the valid values are **1** to **3**.
- If PeriodUnit is set to **month**, the valid values are **1** to **9**.

> This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is **Prepaid**.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
包年包月实例的购买时长，取值：
- 当PeriodUnit为**year**时，取值范围为**1**~**3**。
- 当PeriodUnit为**month**时，取值范围为**1**~**9**。

> 仅当实例的付费类型为**Prepaid**时，需要填写此参数。
v1_parameters.name: Period

v1_parameters.description_en:
The unit of the subscription period for the subscription instance. Valid values:
- **year**
- **month**

> This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is **Prepaid**.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
包年包月实例的购买单位，取值：
- **year**：年。
- **month**：月。

> 仅当实例的付费类型为**Prepaid**时，需要填写此参数。
v1_parameters.name: PeriodUnit

v1_parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~144489~~)接口获取。
v1_parameters.name: RegionId

v1_parameters.description_en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).
v1_parameters.description_zh: 资源组ID。资源组详情请参见[查看资源组基本信息](~~151181~~)。
v1_parameters.name: ResourceGroupId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

> If the IP address is set to 127.0.0.1, all addresses are denied access to the instance. For example, 192.168.0.0/24 indicates that all IP addresses in the 192.168.0.XX range are allowed to access the instance.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
添加实例的白名单IP地址，多个白名单IP地址之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 如果IP地址设置为127.0.0.1，表示禁止所有地址访问该实例。例如IP地址为192.168.0.0/24表示允许所有192.168.0.XX的IP地址访问该实例。
v1_parameters.name: SecurityIPList

v1_parameters.description_en: The vSwitch ID in the VPC.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 专有网络下的虚拟交换机ID。
v1_parameters.name: VSwitchId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The VPC ID.

> If both this parameter and the VswitchId parameter are left empty, the network type of the instance is classic network.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
专有网络ID。

> 本参数与VswitchId参数同时为空时表示实例的网络类型为经典网络。
v1_parameters.name: VpcId

v1_parameters.description_en: The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the zone ID.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 可用区ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~144489~~)接口获取。
v1_parameters.name: ZoneId
